CustomObject.description: Vendor value mappings: one row per external value that means something in Work_Item__c vocabulary. Read in both directions - inbound turns an Asana section gid into a Status__c, outbound turns a Status__c back into the section gid to move a task to - so the two can never drift, which two tables would. Records are in source control since build 08 and deploy with the code; only Integration_Secret__mdt records stay out of it.
CustomObject.label: Field Mapping
